column1: # Demonic Pacts League: bounding boxes per league region, source-of-truth.
# Each row is a rectangular world-coordinate bounding box assigned to a
# LeagueRegion. The dumper (LeagueRegionDumperTest) intersects these boxes
# with every loaded OSRS map region (64x64 chunk) and emits the result as a
# regionId -> LeagueRegion TSV consumed by
# shortest-path/src/main/resources/leagues/regions.tsv.
# Boxes are inclusive on both ends. On overlap the box with the larger
# overlap area wins; ties broken by file order only when overlap areas are
# exactly equal — so a huge mainland box can beat a small override unless
# the override's intersection is strictly larger for that map region chunk.
# Put tight land-focused boxes before broad ones; use several smaller
# KARAMJA rectangles instead of one catch-all that swallows adjacent sea.
# Anything not covered by any box defaults to NEUTRAL at runtime
# (always-unlocked). This is intentional for:
#   * Sailing-skill content (The Great Conch, The Summer Shore, The Node)
#     — Sailing is too new to be in this league, so its destinations are
#     simply unreachable rather than gated.
#   * Instances and dynamic regions without a stable region id.
#   * POH, Death's office, Zanaris, the Abyssal Area, Tutorial Island,
#     and other always-accessible niches.
# Sources cross-checked: Demonic_Pacts_League/Areas wiki page (esp. the
# "Notable inaccessible content in Misthalin" list which pulls Fossil
# Island and the Isle of Souls/Soul Wars into MISTHALIN), and the
# banker's briefcase destinations in
# shortest-path/src/main/resources/transports/seasonal_transports.tsv.
# Format:
#   region_name<TAB>xMin<TAB>xMax<TAB>yMin<TAB>yMax
# === Always-blocked overrides (file-order tiebreakers, before MORYTANIA) ===
# Fossil Island sits in the chunks that would otherwise fall into Morytania
# but the wiki lists it under "Notable inaccessible content in Misthalin"
# (no boat from Port Phasmatys, no Bone Voyage, no birdhouses, etc.).
# Wider than the literal land tiles: the box covers the Tar Swamp south
# (down to ~y=3690), the Volcano + Volcanic Mine east (out to ~x=3890),
# and the Bank Chest island north so all visually adjacent chunks are
# locked too. yMin 3680 also overrides Morytania mainland (yMax 3711).
MISTHALIN
# Isle of Souls and Soul Wars are likewise inaccessible per the wiki. The
# island sits west of Feldip Hills in the Shrouded Ocean. Box widened so
# the BJP fairy ring on the northern coast (2264, 2976), the dungeon
# entrance on the east (~x=2295), the eastern beach beyond x=2304, and
# the western cliffs (~x=2080) are all covered. xMax 2351 keeps Feldip
# Hills (cy 45-46) with KANDARIN — Feldip's Kandarin row gives a 4096
# overlap there vs this row's 3072, so Kandarin still wins those chunks.
MISTHALIN
# === Specific overrides (file-order tiebreakers) ===
# Tirannwn: Lletya peninsula extends slightly into Kandarin's mainland box.
TIRANNWN
# Karamja: full north coast strip (Brimhaven west, Brimhaven, Karamja
# Volcano, Musa Point, shipyard). Sits at the same y-band as Kandarin
# mainland (3136-3519) AND Asgarnia mainland (2880-3071, 3072-3519); on
# tie this row wins by file order so the strip is consistently Karamja.
# xMax 3007 stops the strip at Karamja's east coast — chunk cx=47
# (x=3008-3071) is the Karamja-Port Sarim strait + Port Sarim's
# southernmost piers (Asgarnia per the wiki), so it falls through to
# the Asgarnia mainland box instead of being claimed by this strip.
KARAMJA
# Karamja: Crandor (small island south of Karamja).
KARAMJA
# Kandarin: Yanille / Castle Wars / Port Khazard mudskipper coast.
# Same x-band as Feldip / Karamja overrides below — must come first so
# Yanille tile chunks tie-break to Kandarin, not Karamja.
KANDARIN
# Kandarin: Ape Atoll (chunks 42-44, 42-43).
KANDARIN
# Kandarin: Corsair Cove peninsula (Pirate quest hub, NOT Karamja).
KANDARIN
# Kandarin: Crash Island (small island west of Karamja's north coast).
KANDARIN
# Kandarin: Feldip Hills (south of Yanille, west of Karamja).
KANDARIN
# Asgarnia: Warriors' Guild slope on the east side of White Wolf Mountain
# (just east of Catherby/Kandarin, just west of Burthorpe). Capped at
# y=3711 so Weiss at (2860, 3935) stays Fremennik.
ASGARNIA
# Asgarnia: Burthorpe / Troll Country / Death Plateau / GWD strip
# (north of mainland Asgarnia, west of the Wilderness border).
ASGARNIA
# Asgarnia: Entrana (small island west of Port Sarim).
ASGARNIA
# Asgarnia: Pest Control / Void Knights' Outpost (south of Port Sarim).
ASGARNIA
# Desert: Al Kharid town + Al Kharid mine + Emir's Arena.
# Per the league wiki "Al Kharid is a city in the north of the Kharidian
# Desert" — without this override Al Kharid falls to the Misthalin
# mainland box at the same y band. cx 51-52, cy 49-51 covers the town,
# mine, palace, and arena. yMin 3136 is shared with Misthalin mainland;
# this row goes first so the desert chunks tie-break correctly.
DESERT
# Varlamore: Auburnvale + the Auburn Valley north of Civitas illa Fortis.
# Per the league wiki Varlamore explicitly includes Auburnvale (~1411,
# 3361) which is north of the Varlamore mainland yMax. cx 16-29, cy 51-53
# covers Auburnvale, the valley between the Custodia and Hailstorm
# Mountains, and the eastern mountain pass that previously fell into
# Kourend. Kourend mainland still wins at cy 54+ (Hosidius latitude).
VARLAMORE
# Morytania: Mos Le'Harmless and the eastern islands (Braindeath, Dragontooth, Harmony).
MORYTANIA
# Fremennik: Lunar Isle (west of mainland Fremennik).
FREMENNIK
# Fremennik: Ungael (north of Fremennik mainland).
FREMENNIK
# Desert: Sophanem dungeon (precedes Karamja TzHaar undergrounds).
DESERT
# === Wilderness (overlay; takes precedence over Misthalin/Asgarnia at high y) ===
# xMax 3455 (was 3391) extends Wilderness east to the River Salve so
# chunks at cx=53 cy=55-61 stay Wilderness instead of dropping to NEUTRAL
# now that the Misthalin mainland reaches xMax 3455 (at y < 3520) and
# the Morytania mainland starts at xMin 3456.
WILDERNESS
WILDERNESS
# === Misthalin (always blocked during the season) ===
# xMax 3455 (was 3391) extends Misthalin east to the River Salve at
# x=3424-3455 so Mort Myre's western fringe is no longer claimed by
# the Morytania mainland box that previously started at xMin=3392.
MISTHALIN
# Lumbridge swamp caves, Varrock sewers, etc.
MISTHALIN
# Dorgesh-Kaan dungeon (under Lumbridge swamp).
MISTHALIN
# === Asgarnia ===
ASGARNIA
# Mining Guild / Falador sewers / Motherlode Mine ground level.
ASGARNIA
# Motherlode Mine instance.
ASGARNIA
# Ruins of Camdozaal (Asgarnia underground).
ASGARNIA
# Rogues' Den (Burthorpe underground).
ASGARNIA
# === Kandarin (mainland) ===
KANDARIN
# === Fremennik ===
FREMENNIK
# Keldagrim underground.
FREMENNIK
# Blast Furnace instance.
FREMENNIK
# === Karamja (mainland) ===
# Tight box around the actual island (Brimhaven, Volcano, Musa, Shilo,
# Cairn Isle, Tai Bwo Wannai, shipyard). Excludes the open water of the
# Feldip-Karamja strait at xMin < 2752 — those chunks fall through to
# NEUTRAL because there is no walkable path across them anyway.
KARAMJA
# TzHaar / Mor Ul Rek underground (narrowed away from Sophanem dungeon).
KARAMJA
# Karamja cave dungeons (Brimhaven dungeon, etc.).
KARAMJA
# === Morytania ===
# Mainland — capped below the Fossil Island latitude (the override above
# already steals chunks 58-59 / 58-61 for MISTHALIN, but capping mainland
# here makes the intent explicit). xMin 3456 (was 3392) starts Morytania
# east of the River Salve crossing (Salve at ~x=3424); the strip
# x=3392-3455 is the Salve corridor + Lumbridge swamp east edge, both
# Misthalin per the lore and now claimed by the Misthalin mainland box.
MORYTANIA
# Hallowed Sepulchre (Darkmeyer underground instance).
MORYTANIA
# === Desert ===
DESERT
# Sophanem / Tomb of the Pharoahs / Smoke Dungeon underground.
DESERT
# === Tirannwn ===
TIRANNWN
# Prifddinas (instance-style high y coords; covers chunkY 94-97).
TIRANNWN
# Gauntlet lobby instance.
TIRANNWN
# Underground Pass instance.
TIRANNWN
# === Kourend & Kebos ===
# yMin 3456 (was 3264) leaves cy 51-53 for the Varlamore Auburn Valley
# override above; Hosidius (cy 56) and the rest of Kourend stay here.
KOUREND
# Kourend underground (Mount Karuulm dungeons, Lovakengj, etc.).
KOUREND
# Arceuus rune mine (Temple of the Eye instance).
KOUREND
# === Varlamore ===
VARLAMORE
# Varlamore underground (Cam Torum, Alchemical Society, Quetzacalli, etc.).
VARLAMORE
# Fortis Colosseum instance.
VARLAMORE
